ladder_meaning.specified: the statement (or object) is a Lean definition that compiles; nothing is proved
ladder_meaning.proved: a sorry-free Lean theorem exists in the pinned module (author-side text-level check only)
ladder_meaning.kernel-checked: BUILD_EVIDENCE.json records `lake build` success and `#print axioms` ⊆ standard ∪ declared assumed axioms for exactly these source bytes
ladder_meaning.author-side: formalization written by the formal author; statement alignment unreviewed
ladder_meaning.nonauthor-aligned: a distinct reviewer attested that the Lean statement matches the informal statement, bound to the module sha256 (FORMALIZATION_REVIEW_LANE.md)

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §2: "The code proves e^(288/125)>10 using the positive rational Taylor sum through 20" — the rational partial sum

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §4: "elementary bounds on log(1+ε), -log(1-ε) and exp give ratio ... safely between 1-32ε and 1+32ε"
components.lean_statement: def ratio_bound_statement : Prop := ∀ d ∈ ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ), ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ε < 1 / 28 → (1 + ε) ^ (a d : ℝ) / (1 - ε) ^ (b d : ℝ) < 1 + 32 * ε ∧ 1 - 32 * ε < (1 - ε) ^ (a d : ℝ) / (1 + ε) ^ (b d : ℝ)

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §1: ∫_0^a (a-z)^2 e^(-z/2) dz/2 = a^2-4a+8-8e^(-a/2) (informal: a ≥ 0; formal: every real a)
components.lean_statement: theorem cone_integral_identity (a : ℝ) : ∫ z in (0 : ℝ)..a, (a - z) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-z / 2) / 2 = a ^ 2 - 4 * a + 8 - 8 * Real.exp (-a / 2)
components.does_not_claim: that this integral is the conditional cone moment (Gaussian step is specified separately)

components.lean_statement: theorem D2_algebra : (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (25 / 3 - 20 / 3 + 8 - 8 * Real.sqrt (3 / 8)) = D2
components.does_not_claim: the Gaussian moment values 25/3, 5/3, sqrt(3/8) (specified separately)

components.informal_ref: ENCLOSURE.json cone_moments["3"] = "29/6-sqrt(6)"; outward decimal enclosure of that constant

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §1: Var(s)=5/3, E s^4 = 25/3, E exp(-s^2/2) = sqrt(3/8)
components.lean_statement: def gaussian_inputs_statement : Prop := (∫ s, s ^ 4 ∂(gaussianReal 0 (5 / 3 : NNReal))) = 25 / 3 ∧ (∫ s, Real.exp (-s ^ 2 / 2) ∂(gaussianReal 0 (5 / 3 : NNReal))) = Real.sqrt (3 / 8)
components.does_not_claim: truth of the statement; Prop definition against Mathlib gaussianReal, no proof

components.lean_statement: noncomputable def referenceCoefficient (d : ℕ) : ℝ := Real.Gamma (7 / 6) * (3 / 2 : ℝ) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / 3) * coneMoment (d - 1) / (2 * Real.sqrt 3 * Real.pi ^ (d - 1) * Real.sqrt Real.pi)
components.does_not_claim: that c_d,ref equals the parent coefficient; it is the nonperiodic reference expression only

components.informal_ref: coefficient.py reference_coefficient(d): 80-digit outward rational enclosure of c_d,ref (author rational-interval arithmetic)
components.lean_statement: def reference_enclosure_statement : Prop := (ref2Lo : ℝ) < referenceCoefficient 2 ∧ referenceCoefficient 2 < ref2Hi ∧ (ref3Lo : ℝ) < referenceCoefficient 3 ∧ referenceCoefficient 3 < ref3Hi
components.does_not_claim: kernel verification of Γ(7/6), π and root enclosures; informal evidence is the Python interval code

components.lean_statement: def periodization_statement (c : ℕ → ℝ) : Prop := ∀ d ∈ ({2, 3} : Finset ℕ), |c d / referenceCoefficient d - 1| < (periodizationBound : ℝ)
components.does_not_claim: truth of (4); depends on the unformalized parent (main #63) and §3–§4 analysis

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §5: relative perturbation applied to exact rational endpoints
components.lean_statement: theorem perturbed_bounds {c r lo hi δ : ℝ} (hlo : 0 < lo) (h₁ : lo < r) (h₂ : r < hi) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hδ1 : δ < 1) (h : |c / r - 1| < δ) : (1 - δ) * lo < c ∧ c < (1 + δ) * hi
components.does_not_claim: any numerical value; pure real-inequality lemma

components.informal_ref: PROOF.md §5: "The periodization allowance in (4) is applied to exact rational endpoints BEFORE the final outward rounding" — the implication (reference enclosure ∧ (4)) → displayed bounds
components.lean_statement: theorem enclosure_of_reference (c : ℕ → ℝ) (href : reference_enclosure_statement) (hper : periodization_statement c) : enclosure_statement c
components.does_not_claim: either hypothesis; the theorem is conditional on two specified Props
truth for the parent-defined c_d,24; the periodic coefficient is not defined in Lean (parent main #63 unformalized)
